correctness.rationale: Universal bound follows from the invariant adherence endpoints, strict concavity G-double-prime = -2Pa^2/[rho(1-ax)^3] and necessity of negative G-prime at stable endemic interior states, plus exclusion of stable disease-free interior states. Exact-rational six-equilibrium enumeration and 3x3 Jacobian characteristic polynomials were reconstructed and checked with verify.py; all three claimed sinks satisfy strict Routh–Hurwitz conditions.

originality.rationale: The originating full main text and Supplement S2-S4 already provide scalar G and the necessary determinant sign but not the sharp strict-concavity count plus a fully exact all-three-sinks witness. The explicit theorem is not implied by the inspected different SIS imitation, unconformist permanent-immunity convergence, or finite-horizon Poisson masking results. This is bounded priority, not proof of uniqueness.
residual_risks: A 2026 SIS imitation article was available only by abstract and cannot support a definitive full-text NOT_COVERING statement.

The originating study has qualitative figures classifying coexistence; subtle or figure-only coverage of some three-stability regions cannot be categorically excluded, although neither the theorem nor exact rational certificate was located.
Searches and inspected related records cannot establish absolute novelty; independent history and mathematical auditing remain outstanding.

value.rationale: The exact maximum number of locally attracting equilibria and an all-three-regime rational witness address a motivated structural question in behavioral epidemic feedback, clarifying which distinct protective-adherence and disease outcomes can be robust under the same parameters. Neither an arbitrary numerical slice nor a small improvement; no claim of policy consequences or global basin completeness.
